# Chessground

Vendored from [lichess-org/chessground](https://github.com/lichess-org/chessground)
at commit `4ab695e24b83aa476c4e13e22b5248ca31106226` (version `10.1.1`).

`chessground.min.js` was built from `src/chessground.ts` with:

```text
esbuild 0.28.1 --bundle --format=esm --minify
```

The accompanying base, brown-board and cburnett-piece styles are unmodified.
